direction.situation: On a rainy Colombo roadside, Anudi has just asked Kasun whether he runs his small food business alone.
direction.people: Kasun stands frame right, facing Anudi off screen to the left. He wears a faded blue short-sleeved shirt and dark trousers, with empty hands at his sides; he is modest but hopeful.

flow.text: Kasun holds his gaze left, takes a small breath and lifts his chin slightly.

flow.how: Friendly and matter-of-fact at first, growing quietly hopeful as he shares his ambition, a restrained smile forming near the end

flow.text: His lips settle and he holds his position, eyes still on Anudi.

direction.camera: A locked-off, eye-level medium close-up from the road side on a 65mm lens, with the food three-wheeler soft behind Kasun's right shoulder.
direction.sound: Light rain and distant traffic; no music.
